events.verdict: Avdija (POR) and Mobley (CLE) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Simons (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession should remain with Cleveland instead of awarded to Portland.
Hunter (CLE) has his arm slightly extended and when Avdija (PR) swings the ball from right to left and the ensuing contact is marginal.
Avdija (POR) rests his hands on Garland (CLE) before releasing away towards the basket.
Hunter (CLE) legally contests Simons' (POR) jump shot attempt.
Mobley (CLE) briefly places a hand on Sharpe's (POR) body and does not affect his put-back dunk.

Mobley (CLE) initiates illegal contact to Avdija's (POR) head/face as part of a basketball move. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul by Mobley does not meet the criteria for a flagrant foul.
Garland (CLE) obtains a legal guarding position in front of Sharpe (POR) and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Simons (POR) maintains a legal guarding position during Jerome's (CLE) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) legally contests Simons' (POR) driving shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) wraps his right arm around Camara's (POR) body, which affects his SQBR during the drive.
Garland (CLE) commits a take foul on Simons (POR).
Murray (POR) commits a take foul on Garland (CLE).
Strus (CLE) attempts to obtain a legal guarding position in Simons' (POR) path, but Simons is able to move around him during his driving shot attempt. Any contact that occurs on the play is marginal.
Sharpe (POR) legally contests Hunter's (CLE) shot attempt.
Reath (POR) briefly places an arm over Hunter's (CLE) shoulder, but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Simons (POR) legally contests Strus' (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) turns into Camara (POR) and delivers contact during the pick.
Strus (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position during Camara's (POR) driving shot attempt.
Simons (POR) legally contests Jerome's (CLE) driving shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) cleanly deflects the pass away from Sharpe (POR).
Avdija (POR) initiates contact with Hunter's (CLE) arm after his gather, which affects his shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) moves along with Reath (POR) and immediately slides his hands off of him to allow him to move freely.
Avdija (POR) legally contests Hunter's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Strus (CLE) establishes himself in a position in front of Sharpe (POR) and any contact that occurs after the ball is deflected is incidental.
Strus (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact initiated by Sharpe (POR) during his driving shot attempt.
Hunter (CLE) legally contests Avdija's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Jerome (CLE) and Reath (POR) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Simons (POR) commits a take foul on Hunter (CLE).
Garland (CLE) legally contests Simons' (POR) jump shot attempt.
